title: Design and evaluation of 2-(4-((2-(2-((2,6-dichloro-3-methylphenyl)amino)benzoyl)hydrazineylidene)methyl)phenoxy)acetic acid as a dual anti-inflammatory and anti-diabetic agent.
authors: Elgohary, Mohamed K; Elkotamy, Mahmoud S; Alkabbani, Mahmoud Abdelrahman; El-Khatib, Ahmed Mohamed; Ibrahim, Aya Mohamed Ahmed; Alshabi, Ali Mohamed; Almehizia, Abdulrahman A; Naglah, Ahmed M; Ghabbour, Hazem A; Abdel-Aziz, Hatem A
one_liner_zh: 该文设计合成小分子化合物并评估其抗炎抗糖尿病活性，仅涉及药物靶点分子对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: AIMS: This study aimed to design, synthesize, and evaluate a novel meclofenamic acid derivative (7) for its potential as a dual-target therapeutic agent with anti-inflammatory, antidiabetic, antioxidant, and anticancer activities. MATERIALS & METHODS: Compound 7 was synthesized and subjected to in vitro, in vivo, and in silico evaluations. Anti-inflammatory activity was assessed using acute and chronic models, including IL-6 and NF-kappaB quantification and histopathology. Antidiabetic potential was evaluated through alpha-glucosidase inhibition, glucose tolerance, and alloxan-induced diabetic models. Antioxidant activity was tested against ascorbic acid, while cytotoxicity was assessed on MCF-7, T24, and A-549 cell lines. Molecular docking, ADME profiling, and pathway analyses were performed to predict drug-likeness and target interactions. RESULTS: Compound 7 exhibited potent anti-inflammatory activity (IC(50) = 0.07 microM), reducing IL-6 and NF-kappaB by 62.99% and 59.13%, respectively. It demonstrated strong alpha-glucosidase inhibition (IC(50) = 12.78 microM) and improved insulin regulation. Antioxidant activity was comparable to ascorbic acid. Cytotoxicity studies revealed moderate anticancer activity with synergistic enhancement when combined with cisplatin. CONCLUSIONS: Computational and experimental findings suggest that compound 7 exhibits favorable drug-like properties and holds promise as a multi-target therapeutic candidate.
abstract_zh: 目的：本研究旨在设计、合成并评估一种新型甲氯芬那酸衍生物（7），探讨其作为具有抗炎、抗糖尿病、抗氧化及抗癌活性的双靶点治疗剂的潜力。材料与方法：合成了化合物7，并进行了体外、体内及计算机模拟评估。通过急性和慢性模型评估抗炎活性，包括IL-6和NF-kappaB定量及组织病理学检查。通过α-葡萄糖苷酶抑制、葡萄糖耐受及四氧嘧啶诱导的糖尿病模型评估抗糖尿病潜力。抗氧化活性以抗坏血酸为对照进行测试，同时评估了其对MCF-7、T24和A-549细胞系的细胞毒性。进行了分子对接、ADME分析和通路分析，以预测药物相似性和靶点相互作用。结果：化合物7表现出强效抗炎活性（IC(50) = 0.07微摩尔），分别将IL-6和NF-kappaB降低62.99%和59.13%。其显示出强α-葡萄糖苷酶抑制活性（IC(50) = 12.78微摩尔），并改善了胰岛素调节。抗氧化活性与抗坏血酸相当。细胞毒性研究显示，与顺铂联合使用时具有中等抗癌活性及协同增强作用。结论：计算和实验结果表明，化合物7具有有利的药物相似性，并有望成为多靶点治疗候选药物。
